title: afro sand that stops being fed
story: Afro drums at 123 BPM: each low drum flashes the grains and kicks the gravity, each slap flicks the sand sideways in alternation, and the roll 13872-13915 throws the whole stream from alternating origins, escalating. Every half bar the fan opens and closes. At 13971 the drums and the sand stop being fed (rms falls to zero by 14034): densidad drops, gravity pulls the grains down and then settles, and the last grains glint and fade to a dim, non-black end.
